title: World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2610.24061v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. translated_title: SWECraft世界：通过模拟软件世界实现大规模智能体协作
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体团队承担越来越大的项目和长期悬而未决的开放性问题，智能体协作为扩展推理时计算提供了另一个维度。为了理解什么使这种协作有效且可扩展，我们开发了Software World，一个用于在真实软件生态系统中模拟多智能体协同工作的框架。该框架附带一个流水线，可以创建由真实的、相互依赖的、具有不同主题、规模和依赖结构的Python包组成的环境，我们称之为“软件世界”。在模拟中，智能体维护世界中的软件包，其高层目标是提高软件效率，它们可以自由地发现要处理的任务并与其他智能体协作。我们通过测量隐藏依赖包中的加速比来整体评估智能体在一个世界中的工作成效。该框架使我们能够通过改变通信方式、所有权和资源分配来研究协作的不同要素。我们运行模拟
tldr: 提出Software World（SWECraft）框架，通过模拟由真实Python软件包构成的软件生态世界来研究多智能体协作，以隐藏依赖包的加速作为统一评估指标，系统考察通信、所有权和资源分配等要素对协作效果与可扩展性的影响。
en_tdlr: We introduce SWECraft (Software World), a framework that simulates multi-agent coworking in realistic ecosystems of interdependent Python packages, using speedup in hidden dependent packages as a unified metric to study how communication, ownership, and resource allocation affect effective and scalable agent collaboration.
